defect: The generic buck enable path applied TPS54302-specific equations and limits to live LM61460AANRJRR power_som U4 on both boards. Prior aggregate PASS receipts therefore did not qualify that enable network.

implementation.device_scope: Restrict the existing enable equations to TPS54302. Other detected buck families on the series-fed enable path produce an explicit unverified reason instead of wrong-device calculations.
implementation.result_model: SpiceResult retains completed checks and separate unverified reasons. Any unverified reason prevents aggregate success, survives ngspice cross-checking, appears in errors and JSON, and is printed in generated test plans. A real failed calculation still makes the report FAIL rather than hiding behind UNVERIFIED.
implementation.hardware_changes: None. R12, D5, C20 and all electrical limits remain unchanged. No fabricated input-current bound or nominal-only replacement was introduced.

source_review.visual_review: Pages 4 and 5 rendered with Poppler and inspected: operating conditions and absolute maxima are distinct; enable input current is typical-only. Page 13 section 8.3.1 also describes direct VIN enable as a supported self-start arrangement.
source_review.implication: Do not transplant TPS54302 behavior or treat a typical LM61460 current as a guaranteed bound. A direct-VIN simplification is a candidate for further system-level review, not an implemented or qualified change.

tests.coverage: Partial coverage and mixed failure status; JSON unverified transport; both frozen board fixtures explicitly corrected for precisely two obsolete enable checks; ngspice cannot clear the missing model; mandatory live devkit gate fails visibly; current test plans expose the reason. Other frozen calculations retain their prior oracles. Test-only document format comparison reconstructs the old presentation separately, never production output.
tests.structural_checks: carrier and devkit_mini power_som circuit-check commands exit 0; completeness is not electrical qualification

qualification_status: This supersedes prior complete-build PASS as evidence for device-specific enable correctness. Previously measured PCB geometry and timings remain historical observations, not renewed whole-board qualification. No new full board render or performance comparison was run; the mandatory electrical gate is intentionally non-green until the real qualification gap is resolved. The physical circuit has not been proven faulty by this change.
next_work: Review the inherited TPS54302-era R12/D5/C20 network against the LM61460 always-on requirement. Evaluate a datasheet-supported direct VIN connection, including startup/filter/sequencing consequences and all authoring, canonical-data, placement-contract and regression impacts, or provide a genuinely bounded device-specific model. Independently qualify both boards after the selected correction. Continue carrier placement optimisation and the remaining goal outcomes; no completion claim.
